context:
Search the ClickHouse adapter for try/except blocks in query execution methods.
Look for patterns where the exception is caught to set status=FAILED but the
error message is not stored. Ensure the error field in QueryResult is populated.
description:
The ClickHouse adapter captures failure status but swallows the exception message.
read_primitives and tpcdi result JSONs show "status": "FAILED" with no error string,
making diagnosis of query failures much harder.

The adapter's query execution error handler should always capture str(exception)
into the result object. This is Pattern G from the SF1 failure analysis.

anti_patterns.dont: catch exceptions without storing str(e) in the result error field
anti_patterns.why: swallowed errors force manual re-runs for diagnosis

anti_patterns.dont: change query execution flow or retry logic
anti_patterns.instead: only add error message capture to existing except blocks

preserves.behavior: Query execution flow and retry logic unchanged

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -v -k 'clickhouse and (error_capture or error_message)'
verifications.description: Error messages appear in query results when queries fail
verifications.expected: Tests pass confirming str(exception) is stored in result.error for failed queries

work_units.summary: Find the ClickHouse adapter's query execution error handler - locate where exceptions are caught but messages discarded
Ensure str(exception) is always written to the result error field
Add unit test verifying error messages are captured in query results
